title: On the Adversarial Vulnerability of Neural Receivers with Unrolled LDPC Decoders
abstract: arXiv:2610.30345v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural receivers for 5G New Radio (NR) match classical model-based receivers in link-level performance, but their robustness to adversarial perturbations at the receiver input remains underexplored. We show that standard gradient-based attacks applied end-to-end through an unrolled low-density parity-check (LDPC) decoder fail to significantly outperform a matched-power Gaussian perturbation. We identify the failure as gradient masking caused by tanh saturation in the boxplus operation of the belief-propagation (BP) check-node update, with a per-iteration gradient norm decay of more than four orders of magnitude across ten unrolled BP iterations. Based on this finding, we propose two structurally independent loss functions that restore attack efficacy. translated_abstract: 面向5G新空口（NR）的神经接收机在链路级性能上可与经典的基于模型的接收机相媲美，但其对作用于接收机输入的对抗扰动的鲁棒性仍然缺乏充分研究。我们表明，通过展开式低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）解码器端到端施加的标准基于梯度的攻击，无法显著优于等功率的高斯扰动。我们将这一失败归因于梯度掩蔽，其源于置信传播（BP）校验节点更新中boxplus运算的tanh饱和，在十次展开的BP迭代中，每次迭代的梯度范数衰减超过四个数量级。基于这一发现，我们提出了两种结构上相互独立的损失函数以恢复攻击的有效性：L_BP通过逐迭代监督将梯度引导至未饱和的早期迭代，而L_LLR是作用于解码前对数似然比（LLR）上的间隔损失，其梯度……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文揭示了神经接收机中展开式LDPC解码器因boxplus运算的tanh饱和产生梯度掩蔽、使标准对抗攻击失效，并提出两种结构独立的新损失函数（L_BP与L_LLR）成功恢复了攻击效力。
